title: valeriana valerianella
intro: Valeriana valerianella, commonly known as the dwarf valerian or small valerian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Valerianaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of restlessness and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana valerianella are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its ability to modulate the central nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana valerianella include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
